Laguna at a glance

Our catalogue currently lists 11 development projects in Laguna: 1 villa, 2 townhouses, 8 condominiums. Advertised starting prices run from ฿8,132,000 to ฿129,900,000 (10 of 11 projects publish a price; the rest are on request). Ownership offered by the developers: freehold and leasehold, so please confirm the exact title with your lawyer before buying.

About Laguna

Laguna Phuket is a large integrated resort community on Bang Tao Bay, in Choeng Thale, Thalang district. According to Banyan Group's own descriptions it spans more than 1,000 acres of parkland, lagoons and about five kilometres of coastline, with a golf course, spas, restaurants and a beach club.

This page lists projects located inside Laguna Phuket or in its immediate residential estates such as Laguna Lakelands and Laguna Park. Because Laguna sits within the wider Bang Tao area, each project appears on one of the two pages only.

Neighbouring areas in our catalogue: Bang Tao · Cherng Talay
